features.quote: A single run cannot burn unbounded cost, wall time, or steps, even if the subject loops forever.
features.justification_quote: A single run cannot burn unbounded cost, wall time, or steps
Without caps a single run could consume the entire cost budget. The caps guarantee termination.

features.quote: The system prompt tells the subject it may say the word `ABANDON`... to stop. The loop detects this and terminates
features.justification_quote: Giving the subject a sanctioned exit path makes that mode observable and measurable rather than only inferable from silence.

features.quote: It also keeps the loop from forcing a model... to thrash until it hits a budget cap
features.justification_quote: which would conflate "gave up" with "ran out of resources."
